messages:
mae: Heads-up — dashboard shows NEGATIVE per-token cost for mobile-search route after prefetch credits. Anyone else seeing this?

vikram: I saw that. Looks like prefetch credits are being applied as a full negative line item then the token cost is zeroed elsewhere, so net goes negative :thinking:

jordan: Can you paste an example row? I want to see the raw attributes we get from the router event.

mae: here's a sanitized event for one invocation:

```json
{
  "route":"mobile-search",
  "tokens":120,
  "model":"llama-70b-q4o",
  "base_cost":0.012,
  "prefetch_credit":0.015,
  "cache_origin":"prefetch",
  "timestamp":"2026-03-20T17:12:03Z"
}
```

mae: UI currently just sums base_cost - prefetch_credit at the route level. That makes the 'effective_token_cost' negative which breaks the heatmap color logic and customers are confused.

vikram: ah — our ingestion schema isn't emitting `cache_origin` consistently. Sometimes prefetch_credit is attached to the prefetch event and sometimes to the hotpath. We need a single canonical attribution tag.

jordan: Agree. Two parallel asks:
- API/schema: add `cache_credit_source` (enum: prefetch|hotpath|shared_pool) on cost events
- Dashboard: compute `effective_unit_cost = max(0, base_cost - credit_alloc)` and show a separate line for "credit_applied"

mae: UX note — please show both absolute savings and percent-of-burn. Negative numbers confuse finance teams.

vikram: I'll open a backend ticket to change the emitter and migration plan. We should backfill last 7 days with best-effort attribution.

vikram: Ticket INF-1289 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1289

enginex-bot: schema migration scheduled: cost_events.v2 -> rolling deploy start at 2026-03-22T01:00Z

costbot: FYI — applying a patch in the console to avoid negative heatmap colors. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4212

jordan: For the console change, can we show a subtle badge on routes that have >5% of their cost from credits? Helps explain big deltas.

mae: yes please. Also add a hover tooltip explaining prefetch vs hotpath credits.

vikram: plan: (1) add `cache_credit_source` to emitter + backfill, (2) temporary UI clamp to 0 for effective_unit_cost, (3) add credit breakdown panel and badge, (4) rollout and monitor via canary on eng-only workspace.

jordan: ETA for the backend change?

vikram: aiming for end of week. I'll post progress in #eng-platform. If we need faster, I can do a hotfix for the console clamp.

mae: Thanks — can we also ensure the billing export keeps original fields so finance can reconcile? Don't want to lose the raw credit numbers.

vikram: yes, we'll add `raw_credit_amount` to the billing export and keep backward compatibility.

mae: ok cool. I'll add a small acceptance test for the heatmap colors. :white_check_mark:

costbot: deploy succeeded to staging: console/pr/4212 deployed @ 2026-03-21T09:03Z

jordan: leaving a note — this surfaced because a customer ran large prefetch workloads. We should add an alert if route-level effective_unit_cost flips sign after credits.

vikram: agreed. INF-1290 for alert rule.

mae: thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a short blurb for product so they can pre-empt customer questions.
